comparison.objective: Advance seal segments around a turbine-ring groove, handing them between robot arms; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Groove-constrained segment feeding, regrasping, and bimanual handoffs versus hex-key engagement, counterholding, fine collar rotation, and bounded tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Seal segments are correctly run around the groove versus two safe repeatable carriage stops with stable adjustment. No task specs are available beyond the short body.
comparison.reason: Although both require bimanual dexterity, seal routing and handoff test a different mechanism and result.
